name: Pro IDE Contribution (fixture)
description: Fixture plugin that exercises the managed Pro IDE pathway end to end (ADR-0088): manifest.ide → normalizeIdeManifest → signed proxy VSIX → side-load → broker handshake → contribution render → provider round-trip. Contributes one command and one CodeLens provider that annotates the first line of any file with a lens whose click invokes that command. Use it to verify the whole chain without needing a real third-party plugin.
author: cognia-next

zh-CN.manifest.name: Pro IDE 贡献（测试夹具）
zh-CN.manifest.description: 端到端验证托管 Pro IDE 通路（ADR-0088）的夹具插件：manifest.ide → normalizeIdeManifest → 签名代理 VSIX → 侧载 → 代理握手 → 贡献渲染 → 提供方往返。贡献一条命令和一个 CodeLens 提供方，在任意文件第一行显示可点击触发该命令的 CodeLens。无需真实第三方插件即可验证整条链路。
